content.title: Welcome to Gamers Den — A Long-Term PvE ARK Experience
content.text:
Welcome to Gamers Den!

Gamers Den runs on dedicated hardware with extensive automation, monitoring, backups, and redundant safeguards designed to protect player progression and keep the cluster running reliably.
This is a no-wipe cluster built for long-term play. Server maintenance, updates, restarts, backups, and recovery systems have been designed around preserving the time players invest in their bases, dinos, characters, and progression.

Your progression matters here. The infrastructure behind Gamers Den is built with that in mind.

-=BUILT FOR EVERY PLAYSTYLE=-
Whether you're a solo survivor, part of a long-term tribe, a builder, breeder, collector, or returning player, Gamers Den is designed to give you room to play ARK your way. PvE is the foundation of the cluster, with optional Tribe War available for players who want consensual PvP.

-=ONE CLUSTER • ONE COMMUNITY=-
All maps share the same rates, permissions, economy, and core server systems. Transfer between maps, explore the full cluster, and keep your progression connected wherever you choose to play.

-=PRIVATELY OWNED • COMMUNITY FOCUSED • NO WIPES=-
Gamers Den runs on dedicated hardware and is built around long-term stability. We don't run scheduled wipes, so the base you build, dinos you breed, and progress you make are intended to stay with you.

-=START HERE=-
Check the Rules and Server Rates tabs above for the important information you'll need before getting started. Additional tabs cover cluster features, decay, mods, commands, and other server systems.

content.title: Building Rules – Gamers Den
content.text:
All violations are subject to warnings or immediate bans depending on severity.

Base Limit
* Each tribe is allowed 2 bases per map.
* A base is any cluster of structures.
* All structures must be within render distance of each other, 
   including any perimeter walls.
* A third base will be removed without warning.

Open-World Structures 
* Do not spam structures outside your base.
* All taming structures must be removed immediately after use or
  left unlocked for public use.
* Spawn locations must not impact others and are limited to single foundation/bed(s). One per render area - Don’t spam!
* Teleport pads placed outside of your base must be open to public

No Meshing
* No structures or turrets may be placed inside the map mesh.
* Slight(max 50% of structure) terrain clipping for aesthetics is allowed

No Building or Aggressive Dinos in These Areas:
* Artifact Caves
* Obelisks
* Wyvern Nest / Egg Spawn Zones
* Aberration Surface Entrances
* Extinction “Unfobbable” Location (above King Titan Terminal)
* World Borders (no exploiting foundation placement)
* Spawn Zones (no spawn blocking)
* You may build at Extinction OSDs while active, but must remove all structures afterward.

content.title: Game Rules – Gamers Den
content.text:
All violations are subject to warnings or immediate bans depending on severity.

No Hacking or Exploiting
* Abuse of game, mod, or plugin bugs
* Example: Stacking hundreds of vaults inside each other = exploit.

One Character per Player
* Only one character per player per cluster is allowed.
* No second accounts or account sharing.

No Aggression at Spawns/Obelisks
* Do not place aggressive dinos or structures at:
* Player spawn zones or Obelisks

No Meshing or Map Exploits
*Using the map mesh, terrain glitches, or unintended geometry to gain an advantage is strictly prohibited. This includes hiding bases, dinos, structures, or players inside the mesh.

No Insiding
* Stealing from or sabotaging your tribe
* Tribe item replacements will not be issued.
* Choose your tribemates wisely.

No Duping or Cheating
* Duplication, glitching, or any form of cheating

No Scamming
* All trades must be honest and transparent.
* No scamming other players

Dino Stacking Limit
* Max: 2 dinos stacked inside each other.
* Overstacked dinos will be wiped without notice.
* Separate baby dinos once they mature.

Server Performance Responsibility
* Tribes must not cause lag or crashes through structure spam excessive breeding

No Griefing on PvE Servers
* Intentional destruction or killing of other players’ assets on PvE is strictly forbidden.

No Aggressive Dinos on Wander
* Aggressive dinos must be within base walls or “anchored” to a stationary dino at your base.

content.title: World Settings
content.text:
-=GENERAL RATES=-
2x | XP Multiplier
5x | Harvest Amount
2x | Dino Spawn Density
2x | Resource Respawn
2x | Crop Growth
2x | Loot Quality
2x | Fishing Loot
2x | Spoil Time

Resource Respawn reduces the time required for
harvested resources to return. Spoil Time means
food and other perishables last twice as long.

-=PLAYER & DINO STATS=-
2x | Crafting Speed / Level
2x | Lower Dino Stamina Drain
15x | Dino Weight / Level
20x | Player Weight / Level

Player and Dino Weight are gains per level invested,
not multipliers to their starting weight.

-=STRUCTURES & LIMITS=-
2x | Structure Health
50x | Item Stack Size
10 | Tribe Size
100 | Platform Saddle Limit
50,000 | Tame Limit

The tame limit is intentionally high and is not
intended to restrict normal tribe progression.

All core rates are identical across every map
in the Gamers Den cluster.

content.title: Taming & Breeding Settings
content.text:
-=TAMING=-
10x | Taming Speed

Taming is accelerated across the entire cluster,
reducing tame times while keeping normal taming
methods and food choices relevant.

-=BREEDING=-
15x | Maturation Speed
10x | Incubation Speed
10x | Imprint Amount
10x | Shorter Mating Cooldown
32x | Shorter Cuddle Interval

Maturation controls how quickly babies grow.
Incubation speeds up both egg incubation and
gestation.

Imprint Amount increases the progress gained from
each successful imprint. Cuddle Interval reduces
the wait between imprint opportunities.

Breeding rates are identical across every map
in the Gamers Den cluster.

content.title: Max Levels
content.text:
-=MAX DINO LEVELS=-
150 | Standard Wild
180 | Tek
180 | Shiny
190 | Wyvern / Rock Drake

Standard wild creatures can naturally spawn up
to level 150 across the cluster.

Tek creatures can spawn 20% above the standard
wild cap, giving them a maximum level of 180.

Shiny dinos use the upper wild level range and
can spawn up to level 180.

Wyverns and Rock Drakes use higher egg-level
ranges and can hatch up to level 190.

These are wild or hatch levels before taming,
imprinting or player-applied levels.

content.title: Shiny Dino Settings
content.text:
20 / Map | Active Limit
4–7 Min | Spawn Interval
6 Hours | Lifetime
150–180 | Level Range
2x | Enraged Levels
Yes | Spawn on Restart

-=TRAITS & STATS=-
50% | Trait Gain Chance
50% | Trait Upgrade Chance
1.6x | Stat Boost Weighting

Shinies replace normal wild spawns and do not
increase the overall wild dino population.

Shinies spawn at high wild levels, with Enraged
variants receiving increased levels.

Trait Gain and Trait Upgrade give Shinies a chance
to receive or improve traits when generated.

content.title: Decay System
content.text:
-=STANDARD STRUCTURE DECAY=-
30 Days | Default
60 Days | Recognized
Never   | Premium
Never   | Map Protection - Protected Map Only

Standard decay determines how long your tribe's
structures can remain unrendered before becoming
eligible for removal.

-=RAPID DECAY=-
15 or Fewer | Structures
3000 Units  | Detection Area
5 Days      | Decay Time
Exempt      | Admins & Premium

Small abandoned builds and outposts decay faster
than established bases. If 15 or fewer structures
are detected within the rapid-decay area, they can
decay after only 5 days.

IMPORTANT: Recognized and Map Protection do NOT
protect structures from Rapid Decay. A base with a
60-day standard timer can still be considered a
5-day outpost.

-=HOW TIMERS RESET=-
Rendering any structure belonging to your tribe
resets the tribe's applicable decay timers.

You do not need to visit every individual structure.
Simply return to and render your builds regularly.

Use /decaytime while looking at a structure to
check its current decay timer.

-=PROTECTION LEVELS=-
Recognized
Extends standard structure decay from 30 to 60 days.

Premium
Structures do not expire from standard or rapid
decay while Premium protection is active.

Map Protection
Prevents standard structure decay on the protected
map only. Rapid Decay still applies.

After purchasing or receiving protection, relog
to activate it. If protection expires, structures
return to the applicable standard decay timer.

-=OTHER DECAY TIMERS=-
30 Days | Unclaimed Dinos
30 Days | Empty Tribes

Decay exists to keep abandoned structures and
outposts from accumulating while still giving
active players plenty of time away from the cluster.

When in doubt, check your structures with /decaytime.

content.title: SERVER AUTOMATION & PROTECTION
content.text:
-=SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE=-
2:00 AM Pacific | Wild Dino Wipe
3:00 AM Pacific | Daily Server Restart

Scheduled maintenance is automated across the
cluster to keep servers healthy and running
consistently.

Updates are automatically detected and applied.
Servers are returned to service as quickly as
practical after maintenance.

Additional restarts may occur for mod updates,
stability improvements or backend maintenance.


-=AUTOMATED BACKUPS=-
10 Min | Map Backups
10 Min | Player Profile Backups
Enabled | Player Transfer Profile Backups

Map saves and player profiles are backed up
independently every 10 minutes, providing frequent
recovery points if a server or save issue occurs.

Player transfer profiles are also backed up to help
protect characters and progression while travelling
between servers.


-=DEDICATED INFRASTRUCTURE=-
Gamers Den runs on privately owned dedicated
physical server hardware rather than shared
game-server hosting.

Backups, monitoring, automation and recovery
safeguards are designed around long-term reliability
and preservation of player progression.

-=SERVER STATUS BOARD=-
The Gamers Den Discord includes a live Server Status
Board covering every map in the cluster.

Players can quickly see when a server is online,
restarting, updating, offline or experiencing an
issue.

The board provides a central place to check cluster
status before reporting a problem or waiting for a
server to return.


-=AUTOMATED WEB STORE=-
The Gamers Den Web Store is fully integrated with
the cluster and uses automated delivery.

Purchases are processed automatically so eligible
items, packages and other goods can be deployed
quickly without waiting for an admin to manually
fulfil the order.


-=BUILT FOR LONG-TERM PROGRESSION=-
Gamers Den is a no-wipe cluster designed around
long-term progression.

Automation works behind the scenes to maintain the
servers, protect progression, provide player status
information and deliver services quickly.

The goal is simple: protect the time players invest
in their characters, dinos, bases and progression.
